title: 资源总览
focus: Operational overview of registered resources: 3 restrained summarycounts 工作负载/主机/需关注, then useful runtime list grouped Kubernetes and VM with actual-looking sample states and last querytime. Selected warning workload side detail shows replicas3/4, recent restart event, viewmetrics/logs and sendAgent. Distinguish registered scope from whole fleet, not whole CMDB inventory or all clusters.

title: 集群
focus: Clusterlist with names prod-core,edge-cluster, node count,version,readystatus and source. Search+应用/状态, primary 刷新. Right cluster card with capacity CPU/memory simple bars, nodes Ready, workloadcounts, recent event. No complex provisioning/deleting controls.

title: 节点
focus: Kubernetes node table search+集群/状态/角色; node name,Ready,CPU%,memory%,pods,version. One node MemoryPressure muted amber, opens right card two modest CPU memory sparklines and recent events; secondary view workloads or Agent. Clear unit alignment and evenrows, not cloudVM conflation.

title: 工作负载
focus: Deployment StatefulSet list search+集群/命名空间/类型/状态. Columns workload,application,replicas,image version,updated. Checkout selected 3/4 amber. Right detail overview/config/events tabs, rolloutrevision,image digest abbreviated,replica status,events, view pods and调查; no direct dangerous oneclick rollback outside approval.

title: Pod 与容器
focus: Pods table namespace/workload/status filters, name,status,ready,restarts,age,node; selected crashloop checkout pod right card with container list, last termination reason, restartcount, short recent log snippet and 查看完整日志. Cohesive densityno hugecards. No unrestricted shell terminal.

title: Kubernetes 事件
focus: Timestamped Kubernetes event list grouped bydate/namespace; search +cluster/type/time, columns time,Warning/Normal,reason,resource,occurrences. Selected BackOff opens right event context first/lastseen count,source kubelet,resource link, readable message and关联工作负载. No confused incident ownership controls.

title: 命名空间
focus: Namespace runtime list with cluster,quota CPU,memory,podusage,associatedteam,age. Selected checkout namespace side card compact resourcequota used/limit bars plus workloads. No big hierarchytree or destructive deletebutton, allscope from top.

title: 主机与虚拟机
focus: Host table name/IP,OS,CPU%,mem%,disk%,uptime,source; query search+应用/状态. Selected vm-ops-01 right card CPU/memorytrends and OS/kernel metadata,last sampling, associated apps and Agent entry. Proper distinctions between freshdata and source missing. No raw secrets or SSH keys.

title: 网络
focus: Kubernetes Service and Ingress network view with tabs Services/Ingress, search+namespace+type. Table name,associatedworkload,port,address. Selected checkout Service right card ports80->8080,target selector,endpoints3/4 andrelatedIngress. This is configuration and endpoints NOT dynamic service-call graph; no unsupported firewall wizard.

title: 存储
focus: PVC storage table search+cluster/namespace/status. Name,Bound/Pending,capacity GiB,storageclass,claimingworkload. Right mysql-data claim shows PVC-PV-workload relationship as3compactrows,access mode,mount and data source. No faux real-time disk metrics if not measured, no destructive actions.

title: 中间件与数据库
focus: Operational list Redis/MySQL/Kafka, tabs 全部 Redis MySQL Kafka andsearch; instances name,type,associatedapps,connectionstate,lastquerytime. Selected Redis rightcard memory/simpletrend,connections,keycount,source,timewindow and links日志/关联资源/Agent. Small connectordataavailability labels, no database administration or arbitrary SQL console.

title: 审计日志
focus: Timeline grouped 今天 9月21日 / 昨天 9月20日, search+操作者/动作/结果/应用/时间 uniform toolbar. Timeline events update connector,approve recovery,create Runbook with avatar/time/result/object. One expanded event rightside details before/after,requestid,actor,scope,source. Actual result tag not inferred from prose. No massive table, no log rawjson wall, detailed audit timeline with loadmore.
